comparison.objective: Choose fitting tweezers and peel protective film from a display carrier while stabilizing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool selection, bimanual carrier stabilization, tab grasping, controlled peeling, and tool return.
comparison.success_condition: Film fully detached and supported outside the carrier; carrier excursion limited; both tweezers returned; hands clear and objects still.
comparison.reason: Peel-force control and tool selection differ materially from precision rail/jig butt alignment and continuous bearing-element support.
